name: local-support-memory-desk
description: Compounding Support Desk — an AI IT support assistant that retrieves prior tickets, drafts a grounded suggestion, and saves verified fixes as reusable playbooks.

appManifest.name: Compounding Support Desk
appManifest.description: Retrieves relevant historical tickets and verified playbooks, checks current ticket volume for mass-incident signals, drafts a grounded suggestion, and — once a human confirms the fix actually worked — saves it as a reusable playbook for qualifying future tickets.
